question: Should OpenClaw adopt this core AI-safety event taxonomy and exporter contract once its privacy/cardinality schema is approved, or keep safety observability on existing generic/plugin-defined events?
rationale: The implementation depends on a new cross-core semantic contract and a security-sensitive decision about which identifiers may leave the process; code inspection alone cannot choose that permanent product boundary.

options.title: Approve dependency-gated taxonomy
options.body: Approve the canonical core schema and privacy rules first, then review the linked exporter PR against that exact contract.

options.title: Keep generic exporter events
options.body: Decline a new core taxonomy and require safety integrations to compose existing diagnostics events through plugins or external collectors.

recommendation.title: Approve dependency-gated taxonomy
recommendation.body: Approve the canonical core schema and privacy rules first, then review the linked exporter PR against that exact contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent review and merge history spans both diagnostics exporters, and this decision crosses exporter, core-event, privacy, and product boundaries.
